key.name: timeout-seconds
key.description: Seconds to wait before confirming the selected window.

key.name: include-minimized
key.description: When enabled, minimized windows will be included in the cycle (default off).

key.name: current-workspace-only
key.description: When enabled, only windows from the active workspace are cycled (default on).

key.name: enable-debug
key.description: Prints tracing messages into the system journalctl.
